basis: Contractures and skin webs define syndrome; oral clefts 30-79%, malocclusion 2/3 and ptosis 2/2. Hypogonadism (30-79%) omitted at cap; neonatal distress may be transient.

decisions.ocular: involved: characteristic congenital ptosis is a persistent eyelid defect, reported in 2/2 patients.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypogonadism is annotated 30-79%, but characteristic ocular and oral abnormalities take priority under the four-axis cap.

basis: Facial palsy and hearing loss each 30-79%; nail dysplasia/cutaneous syndactyly 80-99%. Ptosis (30-79%) omitted at cap; optic atrophy <30%.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent nail dysplasia and cutaneous syndactyly occur in 80-99%, supporting structural nail and skin involvement.

basis: Inherited branched-chain amino-acid metabolic umbrella; neurologic injury varies substantially by subtype, and a group-wide frequency of at least 30% is not established.

decisions.neurologic: none: neurotoxicity is prominent in MSUD and several other subtypes, but persistent neurologic damage in at least 30% across this heterogeneous umbrella is not established.

basis: Severe neurodevelopmental impairment defines syndrome; limb hypoplasia occurs in 30-79%. Hearing loss in one reported patient does not establish a syndrome-wide frequency of at least 30%.

decisions.otologic: none: sensorineural hearing loss is reported in only 1/1 patient; this isolated observation does not establish involvement in at least 30% of patients.

basis: Distal motor neuron degeneration defines disease; progressive denervation produces persistent distal skeletal muscle atrophy in most patients (>50%).

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: chronic denervation causes actual muscle tissue loss in most patients (>50%); this exceeds weakness alone and is part of the disease.

basis: Hereditary motor neuron degeneration; persistent thenar and distal leg muscle atrophy is characteristic in most patients (>50%), with associated foot deformity.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: characteristic distal denervation atrophy causes lasting muscle tissue loss in most patients (>50%); an intrinsic myopathy is not required for this tier.

basis: Subaortic stenosis and short stature define syndrome; scoliosis/kyphosis occur in 30-79%. Vocal cord malformations occur in 80-99%, with respiratory insufficiency in 30-79%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: short stature is a defining named feature, supported by structural spinal abnormalities occurring in 30-79%.

basis: Neurodevelopmental syndrome; strabismus occurs in 7/12 (~58%) and skeletal abnormalities in 30-79%. Feeding difficulty and hypotonia alone do not establish gastrointestinal or muscle damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: skeletal-system abnormalities are explicitly annotated as frequent (30-79%), supporting skeletal involvement independently of hypotonia.

basis: Skin, CNS and ocular anomalies are diagnostic; retinopathy 80-99%. Valve disease/PAH occur in 30-79%. Bone lesions (30-79%) omitted at cap, prioritizing severe pulmonary hypertension.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: valve abnormalities and pulmonary arterial hypertension are annotated 30-79%; potentially severe vascular dysfunction takes priority at the cap.
decisions.ocular: primary: ocular malformations form a major diagnostic component of ECCL; retinopathy is annotated 80-99%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: osteolysis, bone cysts and skeletal neoplasms qualify at 30-79%, but are omitted under the four-axis cap in favor of severe cardiovascular involvement.

basis: Hereditary amyloid disorder defined by progressive gastrointestinal dysfunction and autonomic neuropathy; renal amyloidosis/CKD occur in 30-79%. Cardiac and hepatic involvement are <30%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: progressive gastrointestinal dysfunction from visceral amyloid deposition is explicitly part of the disease definition.
decisions.neurologic: primary: autonomic neuropathy is explicitly defining despite its occasional HPO annotation; median nerve entrapment is additionally annotated 30-79%.
